title: Add branch_id writes, ancestor lineage queries, and non-destructive branch persistence to StreamStore

sections.what: Wire branch_id end-to-end through StreamStore writes, batch syncs, and lineage-aware reads so forked branches inherit parent events up to fork_tick/fork_seq while isolating post-fork events per branch.
sections.why: Although stream_events has a branch_id column in engine/stream_store.py, append_event and append_events_batch currently omit branch_id (writing every event to 'main'), query_events does not walk parent ancestry, and POST /api/stream/batch?replace=true wipes the entire world_id across all branches.
sections.how: Update StreamStore.append_event and append_events_batch in engine/stream_store.py to accept and insert branch_id (default 'main') and include branch_id in _row_to_event. Replace world-wide clear on branch batch sync with clear_branch(world_id, branch_id, from_tick=None) so syncing a branch DOM never wipes other branches. Add TimelineManager.get_ancestry(branch_id) in engine/timeline.py returning [(branch_id, min_tick, max_tick, max_seq), ...] and StreamStore.query_branch_lineage(...) wired into GET /api/stream in routes/stream_ops.py when branch_id is passed or active.

acceptance.text: StreamStore.append_event and append_events_batch persist branch_id on every inserted row
POST /api/stream/batch with replace=true replaces only the active branch (or rows at/after fork_tick on that branch) and never deletes parent or sibling branch events
TimelineManager.get_ancestry(branch_id) returns ordered (branch_id, min_tick, max_tick) segments from root main to active branch
GET /api/stream?branch_id=<id>&tick_to=<tick> returns ancestor events up to each fork point plus active branch events after fork_tick without cross-branch contamination

custom.browser_ui: Timeline modal (#timeline-view) and #event-stream display inherited history prior to a fork plus only the selected branch's own events after the fork, keeping sibling branches intact in SQLite.
